name: Menu
description: Full-featured dropdown menu: checkboxes, radio items, submenus with a safe-triangle, shortcuts, typeahead and APG keyboard navigation; opt-in data-motion="glide" (opens from the trigger’s corner, a single highlight that glides between items, submenus that slide in).
useWhen: A button opens a list of actions, such as a row's Edit, Duplicate and Delete
Actions need checkable items, radio groups, shortcuts or nested submenus
An account or overflow menu must open from a trigger with full keyboard and typeahead support

avoidWhen.when: The user is choosing a value to submit with a form
The panel holds a form or rich interactive content rather than a list of actions
Actions should appear at the pointer on right-click or long-press

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Panel position relative to the trigger (automatic flip/shift).

attributes.name: data-motion
attributes.description: Opt-in (on mv-menu, mv-context-menu or an ancestor): the panel blooms from the corner closest to the trigger (based on data-side / data-align), a single highlight pill glides from item to item (hover and keyboard) instead of per-item backgrounds, and submenus slide out from their row. Without the attribute, rendering is unchanged.

methods.name: hide({ focus })
methods.description: Closes every level; focus=true returns focus to the trigger.

properties.name: menu
properties.description: Reusable engine (class exported by menu.js, used by Context Menu).

events.name: mv-select
events.description: Cancelable (preventDefault keeps the menu open). detail: { value, label, item, checked?, group? }.

slots.name: first child
slots.description: Trigger: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded and aria-controls are set automatically.

slots.name: <button role=menuitem>
slots.description: Action item; value (or data-value) → detail.value; disabled or aria-disabled; data-variant="destructive".

slots.name: role=menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio
slots.description: Checkable items (aria-checked). Radios are exclusive within their [role=group] (data-name → detail.group).

slots.name: [data-keep-open]
slots.description: On an item: keeps the menu open after selection.

slots.name: [data-submenu]
slots.description: Wraps a menuitem trigger + a nested [data-content]: submenu (hover, → / ←). Items, groups, separators and submenus added later (async lists) are enhanced automatically.

classes.name: mv-menu-label
classes.description: Group label; data-inset aligns it with checkable items.

classes.name: mv-menu-pill
classes.description: Highlight pill created by the engine in glide mode (aria-hidden); tinted red on a destructive item. Uses --mv-menu-highlight.

a11y: APG “Menu Button” and “Menu” patterns: Enter/Space/↓ open on the first item, ↑ on the last; ↑↓ Home/End navigate (roving focus, wrapping), letters trigger typeahead (accent-insensitive), → opens a submenu and ← closes it, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes and continues tabbing. aria-checked on checkable items, aria-expanded on submenu triggers. Hover moves focus (like Radix).
